mapper.select: INSERT INTO transcript_notes (id, workspace_key, source_id, source_version, title, snapshot) SELECT #{id}, #{workspace}, s.id, a.source_version, s.title, a.result FROM transcript_summaries a JOIN sources s ON s.id = a.source_id WHERE a.source_id = #{sourceId} AND a.source_version = #{version} ON CONFLICT (workspace_key, source_id, source_version) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, source_id, title, created_at, snapshot
